title: Spider-Man: The Comics, the Character, and the Culture
summary: An audio-first study of Spider-Man as a landmark superhero comic: the 1962 creation, Peter Parker's early life, the story mechanics of responsibility and secrecy, and later reinventions including Miles Morales and Spider-Gwen.
assumed_background: No prior comic reading is required. The first lecture introduces the original story; later lectures include spoilers for early issues and selected modern adaptations.
This introductory sequence distinguishes mainline comics, alternate comics continuities, and film versions. It is a history and criticism track, not a complete retelling of every published issue.
